task: BRD-006 (Opt-In, Lightweight Evidence Capture for low-Authority Decisions): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Business rules BRU-006-01 to BRU-006-07 trace to ADR-006 sections 4.1 to 4.4 and 5 (opt-in by default, enforced presence, envelope non-interpretation, write-once storage, zero schema expansion, learner decoupling, non-retroactivity) and stay inside ADR-002 and ADR-004.

Metrics are concrete (zero overhead when unopted, zero new record types, zero references in reward calculators), except 100 percent capture in Episode.metadata, which depends on the caller using the episode entry points that FDD-006 now defines.
Out of scope excludes mandatory capture, DecisionFrames for low authority, retroactive backfill and schema validation of the payload, matching ADR-006 and ADR-004.
BRU-006-01 to BRU-006-07 are concrete enough to drive an FDD and contract tests. BRU-006-04 (write-once across the episode lifecycle) was loose about the mechanism and is made precise in FDD-006.
